name: sdlc-intelligence-deep
description: SDLC judgment, expert engineering knowledge, and deterministic helpers for native coding agents without a central Delivery router.

interface.shortDescription: SDLC judgment and on-demand engineering depth for native coding agents.
interface.longDescription: A native multi-Skill Codex plugin that adds proportional SDLC judgment, Tech Lead-style engineering planning, decision-quality human interviews, user/business acceptance, focused domain expertise, codebase-aware implementation methods, and evidence discipline. Native Skill discovery selects capabilities; the plugin does not reproduce a central Delivery router or host agent runtime.
capabilities: Editable BPMN and Flowchart process diagrams
defaultPrompt: Use the installed Skill or Skills whose decision mechanisms materially improve the current job; when multiple Skills are relevant, keep one coherent accountable outcome and use additional Skills as bounded supporting depth rather than competing owners; do not invent a supervisory router or handoff.
For coding, learn the real codebase and nearby representative patterns before introducing a new mechanism, then iterate against real execution feedback.
Apply SDLC controls proportionally to decision-changing risk and evidence; preserve missing or unexecuted proof truthfully.
